headline: Rough patch risk 22% in the next 7 days, mostly from the treatment calendar
summary: Risk of a rough patch in the next 7 days: 22% (alert line 11%). The treatment calendar alone gives 25%; wearable signals move it -3 points. The wearable agrees: Steps 34% below their usual (12,520 vs 19,062 a day, last 3 days).

evidence.label: Steps
evidence.text: Steps 34% below their usual (12,520 vs 19,062 a day, last 3 days)

evidence.label: Check-ins
evidence.unit: daily check-ins skipped in a row
evidence.text: Skipped the last 3 daily check-ins. Across the program, people who come back after 3+ skips report a rough day 1.4x as often; today's wearable estimate: 9% chance today is rough (typical 6%)

evidence.label: Treatment calendar
evidence.text: On treatment (Chemoradiation, weekdays for 6 weeks). The calendar alone predicts 25% risk of a rough patch this week.

recommendations.action: Check in before the usual low point after their dose: energy, eating, fluids. Lower this week's goals.
recommendations.why: Their treatment calendar puts them near the low point, when rough patches usually start.

recommendations.action: Move the next coaching call earlier and plan around the expected low point.
recommendations.why: The forecast covers the next 7 days.

recommendations.action: Send a short, no-pressure message asking how the week is going; offer a 2-minute call instead of the form.
recommendations.why: 3 daily check-ins skipped in a row; rough days are more common after a run of skips.
